name: pi
description: pi: a minimal, extensible agent harness. On Windows use the official PowerShell installer (irm https://pi.dev/install.ps1 | iex); requires Node.js 22.19+. It does not implement A2A or publish an Agent Card; programmatic integration uses --mode rpc (JSONL over stdin/stdout). This entry is kept as a control group showing how a non-A2A asset is registered.

metadata.install: powershell -c "irm https://pi.dev/install.ps1 | iex" (or install Node.js 22.19+ with winget)
metadata.a2a: unsupported — no Agent Card is published; see example/README_cn.md for how the control group is marked
metadata.env_hint: Provider credentials are configured inside Pi with /login, not written into this JSON
